headline: Saree claims drone/missile strikes on Saudi-led forces in Midi, Al-Ghumbar, Ras Al-Aara, Al-Mudharaba and east Al-Jawf
dek: Saree claimed: (1) drone strikes on Saudi-led positions and weapon depots in Midi and Al-Ghumbar, 'precise and direct ... resulting in dead and wounded, as well as the destruction of several weapons depots'; (2) ballistic-missile strikes on Saudi-led mobilisations in Ras Al-Aara and Al-Mudharaba,…
sources: Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree, X posts Nov 3, relayed by Dawn liveblog
fault_line: One spokesman, one day: a string of 'precise' strike claims plus a denial that anything happened at all -- which Saree post is the real one?

sections.what_happened: Saree claimed: (1) drone strikes on Saudi-led positions and weapon depots in Midi and Al-Ghumbar, 'precise and direct ... resulting in dead and wounded, as well as the destruction of several weapons depots'; (2) ballistic-missile strikes on Saudi-led mobilisations in Ras Al-Aara and Al-Mudharaba, 'precise ... dozens of dead and wounded, including leaders'; (3) ballistic-missile strikes on Saudi-led forces east of Al-Jawf, 'direct ... large number of dead and wounded, destruction and burning of several vehicles'. Separate from the Abha/Khamis Mushait claims recorded at 2100-03.
sections.what_verified: Dawn (T3) relay of the claimant's own posts. The strike claims rest on the claimant alone.
sections.what_disputed: Saree himself said on Tuesday that Ansar Allah carried out NO operations toward Saudi territory that day (his denial of the Mecca-attack claim, recorded 1700-02) -- directly in tension with same-day strike claims; the Saudi coalition confirmed only a Mecca-region drone intercept on Tuesday, with no mention of Midi, Ras Al-Aara or Al-Jawf damage. Casualty figures ('dozens', 'large number') are claimant-only with no names, places of burial or imagery in-window.
sections.why_matters: The other Saree claims from Tuesday nobody logged: Midi, Ras Al-Aara, Al-Jawf -- all claimant-only, all dented by his own same-day denial
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Dawn live entries 08:53pm PKT = 19:53 , 06:00pm PKT = 17:00 , 05:44pm PKT = 16:44 ; absent from all earlier Nov 3 scans) -- Saree claims drone/missile strikes on Saudi-led forces in Midi, Al-Ghumbar, Ras Al-Aara, Al-Mudharaba and east Al-Jawf

totw_analysis: Our read: The other Saree claims from Tuesday nobody logged: Midi, Ras Al-Aara, Al-Jawf -- all claimant-only, all dented by his own same-day denial The fault line our audience is arguing over: One spokesman, one day: a string of 'precise' strike claims plus a denial that anything happened at all -- which Saree post is the real one?
